## Courses

Education system courses across the age groups:
- Bot Buddies (Ages 4-7) — playful early coding.
- Code Kids (Ages 8-11) — core programming for kids.
- Code Quest (Ages 12-15) — intermediate challenges.
- AI Lab (Ages 15-17) — AI concepts and building with models.
- Career Launcher (Ages 18+) — job-ready skills.
Course structure includes modules such as logic basics (true vs false) inside Bot Buddies.

## Applications (Age groups)

Each age group has its own hub at /applications/[age]/ with age-appropriate apps and content. Five groups: 4-7, 8-11, 12-15, 15-17, 18+.

## News

A curated AI news portal. Editions are dated (e.g. /news/2026-09-17/) and each edition carries a label plus a set of headline stories with links and commentary. The portal surfaces the latest AI developments in a digestible format.
